disposition_reason: The current scientific target remains retrospective prior-dependent neural-trajectory inference on verified common sampled-interval support, with response-modality/direction controls and held-block uncertainty. The delivered177-trial pre-Set selected-count calculation is a narrower numerical calibration assay: it supplies neither the full response-conditioned Set–Go trajectory endpoint nor the required uncertainty. Its missing local scorer dependency is a separate execution gap. The original target is not redefined to make this mismatch disappear.

scientific_target.question: Over verified common sampled-interval support, do short and long prior contexts differ in a prespecified retrospective Set–Go neural-trajectory contrast after response-modality/direction and temporal-block controls, and what within-session uncertainty supports that conclusion?
scientific_target.known_answer: An independently recomputed matched-prior difference in measured response-conditioned neural trajectories on the complete prespecified eligible interval/modality/direction/block support, together with its support and within-session uncertainty. The contrast may be null, reversed or unsupported; its empirical value is not supplied by the paper narrative. The exact full-trajectory packet, basis and reference remain unqualified.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original DMFC spike observations and verified Ready/Set/Go, prior-context, sampled-interval and response-modality/direction metadata, with train-only trajectory/alignment choices and independently recomputed held-block contrasts. Historical metadata identifies800 ms common prior support but explicitly does not qualify a scientific contrast; current selected pre-Set counts are not the full target.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete source-verified session/common-sampled-interval comparison with trials nested in prior, response modality/direction and temporal blocks. Exact eligible full-trajectory case identities must be frozen after source semantics/support verification; the177-row calibration roster is not silently substituted.
scientific_target.independent_unit: The delivered calibration concerns one already exposed monkey/session. Full-target uncertainty must respect trials nested in session/block; neither neurons nor time bins establish independent animals. No cross-animal replication is supplied here.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective conditional association of prior context with neural trajectories. Full Set–Go alignment is conditioned on the eventual response and cannot support prospective interval prediction or a unique causal timing mechanism. The original evaluation phrase about held-out interval-loss is not satisfied by numerical selected-count reconstruction. The preserved original held-out interval-loss wording is an unresolved metadata inconsistency, not a source-grounded substitute endpoint; prospective behavioral prediction remains separate.
